features.title: Dock an independently bound Conversation view
features.summary: Restore existing independently bound Conversation views without an extra composer. Per-thread occurrences remain addressable for saved layouts but are excluded from reusable view pickers. Fixed conversations also render the original authorized header through the owned public Factory: a single native header declaration, original session-targeted controls and native per-session child-view selection over the same resident editor. Native main mode shares the renderer; the Workbench-only host-corner clearance prevents row recovery from covering the original toolbar.
failureModes: Failed acquisition displays an error instead of another thread.
Removed views or deleted threads retire their source; Workbench keeps its standard unavailable-panel recovery.

externalDependencies.boundary: Public panel source registry and persisted Dockview arrangements.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Typed registry and retained-reference fixture; real public content Factory in scratch.

rehydrates old view panels before any main conversation mounted and binds split Sessions independently

features.title: Rename a thread from its header title
features.summary: Clicking the current Session title in the main view header opens an in-place editor focused on the whole title. Enter or leaving the field commits the trimmed title through the Session rename API, Escape cancels, and a blank or unchanged draft closes without a Host call. The header keeps the breadcrumb shape, so ancestor crumbs still navigate and a subagent's lineage switcher is unchanged.
failureModes: A rename the Host refuses keeps the editor open with an error and the previous title stays on the thread.
An unchanged or blank draft closes the editor without a Host call.

verification.reason: The in-place header editor is exercised end to end by its scratch reach; mounting the slot in a unit harness would require the full Conversation runtime.

telemetry.reason: Client-only: Rename a thread from its header title renders browser state and starts no Host work of its own.

features.title: Composer contract for other plugins
features.summary: Provides dshx's Composer contract: the composer on screen and whether it holds focus, the draft text to read, replace or insert at the caret, file, quote, note and line-comment chips, the next message's model and variant, and focus. Those chips keep their content in the chip, so a restored draft still sends them.
failureModes: Every verb returns false when no composer is retained for the addressed session or the draft is locked by a send in flight.
setModel returns false when no model directory service runs or the Host refuses the selection.

verification.testName: sends a quote as a Markdown block quote under a short label

telemetry.reason: Client-only: the Composer contract edits browser draft state; setModel uses the model picker's existing Host call.
